mainEntity.name: Should I do bathroom tile myself or hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom tile installation is usually best for a professional when the project involves a shower, waterproofing, natural stone, or uneven surfaces. DIY can work for simple dry-area updates, but bathrooms are less forgiving because water, slope, and substrate prep matter so much.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY is possible for simple, dry-area tile jobs, but showers and stone work are usually worth hiring out. The risk of leaks, lippage, and failed waterproofing is much higher in bathrooms.
